A young girl with black hair tied in pigtails, wearing a dark brown t-shirt and red shorts, stands on tip-toes by a white kitchen counter. An adult's hands are visible at the edge of the frame, holding a clear plastic container and preparing small, yellow cubed pieces of apple. (2) The scene shifts as the girl successfully receives a piece of apple. She turns around and walks away from the counter into a living room area with light wood flooring. A calico cat is seen sleeping on a stool in the background near a white shelf unit and various toys. (3) The girl explores the living room, which is filled with toys and child-sized furniture. She finds a blue pen on the floor, picks it up, and holds it triumphantly in the air towards the camera. The lighting is natural and soft, coming from a nearby window. (4) The girl is now lying on a large white beanbag chair next to another young child in a black t-shirt. They are both eating fruit. The girl playfully lifts her shirt to show her protruding belly. The video ends with a pink graphic screen featuring a small character animation and text.
